title: One Chinese Character Hides All 8 Brush Strokes · 书法 | China Travel Expert
description:
One Chinese character — 永, "eternity" — hides every basic brush stroke there is.

That is the secret of 永字八法, the "Eight Principles of Yong": master the strokes in this single character and you can form thousands of others. It is the foundation of Chinese calligraphy, an art practiced for more than 2,000 years and inscribed on UNESCO's Intangible Cultural Heritage list in 2009. It is not just writing — it is painting with a brush, using the Four Treasures of the study: brush, inkstick, paper and inkstone. Every line is said to reveal the writer's own character.

🧭 Expert Tip: At parks and temple fairs you will see 地书 — people brushing giant characters onto stone with plain water. It is free, it dries in minutes, and locals will happily let you try.

一个"永"字，藏着中国书法的八种基本笔画。
